# CodeKraft

> High-Performance Websites, Custom Web Applications & Cybersecurity Engineering

CodeKraft is an independent digital engineering and design studio that designs, builds, and secures digital products, web applications, and modern websites for forward-thinking businesses and founders.

- Website: https://www.codekraft.online/
- Contact WhatsApp: +91 94007 50981 (https://wa.me/919400750981)
- Direct Phone: +91 94007 50981 (tel:+919400750981)
- Contact Email: codekraft.pvt@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/codekraft.ig

## Core Services

- **Web Development**: Fast, high-conversion responsive websites, single-page applications, and interactive digital experiences.
- **Mobile App Development**: Native and cross-platform mobile apps for iOS and Android built with Flutter and React Native.
- **Custom Software Engineering**: Enterprise web applications, APIs, business workflow engines, and backend platforms.
- **UI/UX & Product Design**: User research, wireframing, high-fidelity prototypes in Figma, and design systems.
- **Cybersecurity & Hardening**: Security assessments, vulnerability scanning, TLS/SSL hardening, edge firewall configuration, and DDoS mitigation.
- **Cloud & Edge Infrastructure**: Scalable cloud infrastructure on AWS, Vercel, and Cloudflare edge mesh with automated deployments.

CodeKraft offers 18 distinct pre-built, production-grade website directions across diverse industries:

1. **LUXE ESTATES** (`/01-real-estate/`): Luxury real estate showcase with curated property listings and architectural photography.
2. **MAISON EMBER** (`/02-fine-dining/`): Fine dining and culinary hospitality experience with digital menu and tasting reservations.
3. **flowstack** (`/03-saas/`): SaaS product landing page with interactive workflow animations, tier pricing, and feature highlights.
4. **FORMA ATELIER** (`/04-architecture/`): High-end architecture and spatial design studio portfolio.
5. **NORTHSTAR®** (`/05-digital-agency/`): Creative and digital agency portfolio highlighting case studies and brand strategy.
6. **FORGE ATHLETICS** (`/06-fitness/`): Elite fitness center, personal training, and athletic club website.
7. **AZURE COVE** (`/07-luxury-resort/`): Ultra-luxury island resort and boutique retreat website with booking inquiry.
8. **ATELIER NOIR** (`/08-fashion/`): Minimalist fashion house and designer apparel collection.
9. **AURA HEALTH** (`/09-healthcare/`): Modern medical clinic, private healthcare, and telehealth platform.
10. **LUMEN ACADEMY** (`/10-education/`): Executive learning academy and online courses platform.

12. **TERRA BUILD** (`/12-construction/`): Commercial construction and civil engineering contracting firm.
13. **VOYAGE CURATED** (`/13-travel/`): Bespoke private expeditions and luxury travel journeys.
14. **SILVER & SALT** (`/14-photography/`): Fine art and editorial photography studio.

16. **BOTANICA SPA** (`/16-beauty-spa/`): Holistic wellness, thermal spa, and restorative therapies.

## Technology Stack

- **Frontend**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, HTML5 Semantic markup, Modern Vanilla CSS, Tailwind CSS.
- **Backend & APIs**: Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, Redis, GraphQL, REST APIs.
- **Cloud & DevOps**: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Cloudflare, Vercel Edge Mesh.
- **Design**: Figma, Motion Design, Responsive Systems.
